Greece reports 5 Turkish UAVs and 3 airspace violations on 22 October

22 October 2026 · Central / southeastern Aegean · Greek-reported Turkish UAVs

Greek-authority-reported Turkish UAV airspace violations

Greek authorities reported 5 Turkish UAVs in the central / southeastern Aegean on 22 October 2026, with 3 national-airspace violations and 7 Athens FIR infringements. This is one dated record; the three counts measure different things.

Two accompanying F-16s and one ATR-72, responsible for three further FIR infringements, are excluded. The UAVs were identified and intercepted; no armed engagement, casualties or damage was reported. The airspace assessment remains attributed to Greece. TheOpinion and Edolio5 reproduce matching figures, with closely matching text; they are not treated as independent flight-track verification. The original GEETHA bulletin and precise tracks were not retrieved.
